thread:
Aisha (CS): Heads-up — during two onboarding calls today we captured ~6 distinct asks from different teams. Wanted to align on a lightweight capture + triage flow so nothing slips and we can surface renewal-risk items.
Tom (CS Ops): yes please. currently we shove stuff into a shared doc and it becomes noise :\nAisha (CS): Agreed. Proposing a 1-line capture + tags + urgency score. Something like:
```
Customer: <org>
Type: feature / bug / doc
Problem: one-line description
Why it matters: business impact / renewal note
Proposed triage: P0/P1/P2 / effort estimate / owner
Tags: onboarding, cost, api, docs, security
```
Jordan (PM): love that. Can we add a "customer size / ARR" field? helps prioritize.
Ravi (Onboard Eng): also include "blocking during go-live? Y/N". simplifies quick routing to eng or docs.
Nora (AM): for renewals, please add a short "ask came up in renewal conversation?" flag. If yes, we treat score higher.
Aisha (CS): ok combining: Customer size + blocking + renewal-flag. Thinking storage: Notion table + a small PS ticket for any P0/P1. Anything else?
Tom (CS Ops): two operational asks: 1) we need consistent tags (we should publish a tag taxonomy), 2) want automated slack alerts for P0/P1 so eng can triage quickly.
Jordan (PM): I can wire up a product-board board to ingest rows and sync tags. If CS can maintain the Notion table we can do weekly import.
Ravi (Onboard Eng): quick rubric suggestion for scoring (one-liner so CS can score):
Impact: 0/1/2 (0 low, 2 critical)
Effort: 0/1/2 (0 tiny, 2 multi-week)
Renewal risk: 0/1/2
Score = Impact*2 - Effort + Renewal
Use thresholds: >=3 -> P0/P1 review, else backlog.
Aisha (CS): sounds good — I'll prototype the Notion table and tag list by EOD.
OnboardBot: New ticket created: CS-432 (Aisha) — captures template row inserted.
Nora (AM): :thumbsup: Can you also add a column "owner recommended"? AMs often suggest workaround owners.
Tom (CS Ops): I'll add a small zap to ping #eng-runtime for any row marked P0/P1 with tag "api" or "performance".
Jordan (PM): once prototype ready, let's do a 15-min sync Monday to confirm import flow. I'll invite Ravi + Tom + Aisha.
Aisha (CS): assigning action items: 1) Aisha -> create Notion template + tag taxonomy (due EOD) 2) Tom -> Slack alert zap (due Wed) 3) Jordan -> product-board mapping (due next Fri) 4) Ravi -> quick rubric doc/example (due Tue)
Ravi (Onboard Eng): will post an example scoring sheet in the thread tomorrow.
Aisha (CS): thanks everyone — goal is consistent capture so product sees real signal and we can flag renewal-risk items quickly.
Tom (CS Ops): :100:
Jordan (PM): saved.
Aisha (CS): closing thread for now, will update with Notion link when ready.
